scope: CLI opt-in streaming inventory; Native/Core long job and index binding follow-ups
legacy_route: inventory_budget=None keeps existing explicit MAX_TREE=33554432 until independently qualified
snapshot_id: Existing automation_core.digest(alias, profile, head, tree); preserve JSON defaults
head_rule: Read HEAD once; resolve tree from pinned head; enumerate pinned head and recheck before publish
path_rule: First TAB splits header; NUL terminates record; path bytes remain exact
unsupported_path: existing git-path-hex:<hex>, existing disposition/reason, raw bytes reversible
stage: private disposable disk SQLite outside source; bounded cache/batches/quota; no authority
publication: single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction inserts snapshot(cursor=0,total=N) and N exact entries; no OR IGNORE
existing_id: reuse only scoped valid complete inventory; do not overwrite captured states; corrupt inventory errors
inventory_ready: all tree records committed; capture cursor initially 0; not a COMPLETE capture assertion
snapshot_complete: existing cursor==total, counts, no PENDING and exact raw indexed proof after scan pages
repo_heads_rule: unchanged until existing capture completion, not advanced by CLI inventory
retry: fresh Git enumeration from byte 0 after confirmed process stop; partial stage never resumed
limits: operator budgets explicitly fail; no fixed total file count and no opt-in stdout corpus cap
outstanding: device resource qualification and Windows process lifecycle
